page_title: RAY 1-1 VAL | Rayo Vallecano v Valencia 01/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+3' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani Raba (Valencia) replacing Diego Lopez.
90+2' Substitution. Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) replaces Pepelu.
90+2' That's the end of the game for Alvaro Garcia, who is replaced by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

87' Great solo effort from Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.

86' A long pass finds Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
85' Jose Gaya (Valencia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
83' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Alvaro Garcia.
83' Nobel Mendy has picked up an injury and is replaced by Luiz Felipe (Rayo Vallecano).
81' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' Diego Lopez (Valencia) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Good work from Valencia as they win a corner.
78' Great teamplay by Valencia as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
75' Diego Lopez (Valencia) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
74' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Hugo Duro is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Valencia).
74' That will be all from Luis Rioja who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Filip Ugrinic (Valencia).
73' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
71' The referee is firm and issues Thierry Correia (Valencia) a deserved yellow card.
69' Here is a change. Fran Perez is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Lopez departs the field of play to be replaced by Alemao (Rayo Vallecano).
68' 16:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
64' It's in the back of the net! Diego Lopez (Valencia) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Augusto Batalla. He makes it 1:1.
63' Andre Almeida (Valencia) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
63' Jose Gaya (Valencia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Valencia have a corner.
60' The resulting corner from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.

59' Julen Agirrezabala pulls off a great save to deny Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' The referee allows time for a substitution. Javi Guerra will be replaced by Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia).
56' 8:2 – the corner kicks stats.

52' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.

50' A lofted cross from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' The attendance for today's match is 11267.
48' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' What a chance! Diego Lopez (Valencia) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.

42' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
39' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Julen Agirrezabala (Valencia).
37' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Gerard Gumbau sends a long raking pass onto the head of Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the roof of the net. 1:0.
37' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.
36' Luis Rioja (Valencia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
34' Andre Almeida (Valencia) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
34' Jose Gaya (Valencia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Valencia get a corner.
33' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

32' That's unlucky! Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.
31' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
30' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Valencia.
30' Julen Agirrezabala comes off his line to intercept the corner from Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).

30' A neat pass is well received by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
26' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
25' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) whips in a cross from the corner, but Julen Agirrezabala is well positioned and punches the ball away.
25' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Rayo Vallecano win a corner.
24' Thierry Correia (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Thierry Correia (Valencia) plays a long ball to Hugo Duro, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
19' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
17' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
15' A pass by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
13' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Luis Rioja (Valencia), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
12' Javier Alberola couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
12' Andre Almeida (Valencia) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

11' Great touch by Luis Rioja (Valencia) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save! The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
9' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Thierry Correia (Valencia) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Rayo Vallecano fail to score from a corner as Julen Agirrezabala (Valencia) leaps to collect the ball.

6' A neat pass is well received by Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
5' Valencia enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

1' That was a nice football moment. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Julen Agirrezabala guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
